text:
hana_finance: Proposal from Billing/Product to run a Q2 pricing experiment: cap automatic Dedicated burst billing to 25% of committed capacity per billing period, with manual review for overruns. Need Finance + Legal sign-off before we pilot.

peter_billing: Summary: aim to reduce surprise overage disputes. Implementation: when a customer's burst usage in a month <= 25% of their commit, system bills as normal. If burst >25%, usage above the cap enters "pending review" and is not billed automatically; Billing creates ADJ candidate and tags for Finance review.

jena_product: Rationale from Product: many customer complaints are micro-failovers or short maintenance misroutes that create large token spikes. This cap reduces noise and gives us time to investigate root cause before charging. We'll run for 90 days and measure dispute rate and revenue delta.

ravi_engineering: Ops note: will need two telemetry primitives added: (1) per-commit rolling-window burst metric, and (2) placement-origin tag (hosted vs partner vs maintenance). Also need a safeguard to avoid underbilling in genuine high-demand events. Suggest we allow override where customer-sent spike includes authenticated admin intent header.

olaf_legal: Legal concerns: contract language for Dedicated commits currently implies "usage not covered by commit is billable". We should add an appendix for the experiment so we don't create binding precedent. Draft clause: "Temporary billing experiment: provider may, at its discretion, defer billing of excess burst usage for review. Deferred amounts do not constitute a waiver of billing rights and may be billed after review." Need product + finance to review wording.

hana_finance: Good point. Finance asks that any deferred amounts still be tracked as "potential revenue" in reporting and that we cap the total deferred exposure per customer to a sensible absolute dollar amount (recommend $10k) to limit risk. Also need a reconciliation cadence: Billing to surface pending items weekly and Finance to approve or reject within 14 days.

peter_billing: Implementation details: add reason code DED-BURST-EXPT, create billing views: pending_bursts and deferred_exposure_by_customer. We'll auto-generate BIL tickets for each over-cap event with links to placement logs and incident windows. Billing-bot: create template?

billing-bot: Template created: BIL-EXPT-TEMP - "Deferred burst billing event: attach placement logs, commit id, customer, token count, proposed charge." Use when over-cap detected.

jena_product: Metric targets for the experiment: reduce number of customer disputes by 40% and keep monthly net revenue change within -2% of baseline. We'll A/B test: 50% of new and existing customers who opt-in to experiment. Need CS opt-in flow.

olaf_legal: Also require a customer-visible FAQ entry explaining "deferred billing" and a way to opt out. Customers must be notified in onboarding and via email 14 days before we start applying to their account. Approve experiment with these guardrails.

hana_finance: Finance pre-approval conditional on: (1) deferred exposure hard cap $10k per customer, (2) weekly reporting to Finance, (3) audit trail linking each deferred event to logs and an infra incident if applicable. If Billing can deliver these, Finance approves pilot.

peter_billing: We can deliver those. Will add the cap config and weekly report. My only ask: allow Billing to auto-approve deferred items under $250 to reduce ops overhead. Approve?

hana_finance: Ok to auto-approve under $250 if Billing adds a 7-day auto-bill window: if not investigated within 7 days, item is billed and Finance gets notified. This reduces manual churn.

olaf_legal: Updated draft clause approved by Legal with explicit non-waiver language and opt-out path. Please circulate the appendix to Contracts and CS for review.

peter_billing: I'll open a change ticket CHG-7012 to implement flags, dashboard, and BIL templates. Billing-bot: please create experiment ticket.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BIL-EXPT-7012 - "Pilot: DED-BURST-EXPT (25% cap, deferred billing flow)". Audit trail started.

ravi_engineering: We'll add telemetry and placement tags; aim to deliver staging rollout in 2 weeks and prod in 6 weeks. I'll link the infra PRs in the BIL ticket.

hana_finance: Finance formally approves the pilot with the agreed constraints. Please add weekly report recipients: hana_finance, peter_billing, jena_product, olaf_legal. Also include a short playbook for when deferred items exceed the $10k cap.

peter_billing: Acknowledged. We'll circulate a one-pager for CS and Sales and include an opt-in checkbox on the Dedicated onboarding flow.

jena_product: Thanks team. We'll monitor customer sentiment and revenue impact. If any major partner or legal issue arises we pause immediately. Starting rollout plan now. :rocket:
